business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Structural Drafting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with commercial law heritage; unitary national regime; Corporations Law Ley No. 32 de 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012)
Panama–South Korea Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement
Panama–United Arab Emirates Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement
Panama–Czech Republic Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Governing framework: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended), establishing the national AML/CFT system and the mandatory Beneficiario Final (UBO) disclosure regime; Ley No. 70 de 2019 creating the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) and strengthening UBO verification; Ley No. 254 de 2019 on economic substance; the implementing Decrees and Resoluciones of the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) operating the confidential Registro de Beneficiarios Finales; and the consolidated AML/CFT rulebook of the SSNF applicable to resident agents and legal service providers.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each natural-person UBO and each proposed director/officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport-issuing authority in the UBO's country of origin, with notarial certification and Apostille seal

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for incorporation (Poder Especial para constituir sociedad) executed by the UBO or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction where the UBO or parent entity is located

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Tax Residence (Certificado de Residencia Fiscal) and bank/source-of-funds reference letter for the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent revenue authority and regulated bank of the UBO's tax residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: If corporate shareholder: certificate of good standing, certificate of incumbency, and memorandum/articles of association of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry and registered agent of the parent entity's jurisdiction of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory application of risk-based customer due diligence at onboarding and on a rolling 365-day cycle: (i) screening against OFAC SDN and non-SDN consolidated lists; (ii) United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) Panama's national AML risk list and notices issued by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); (v) FATF public statements on high-risk and monitored jurisdictions; and (vi) PEP determination under FATF Recommendation 12 and Ley 23 de 2015 using commercial global PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, politically exposed family members, and unusual funding patterns. Any direct hit, unresolved false match, or inability to establish the true UBO shall result in immediate rejection of the engagement.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols_no: For this low-risk standard-tier CAD outsourcing scope, the resident agent and compliance officer will issue a written KYB/KYC memorandum documenting PEP-negative and sanctions-negative results prior to the execution of the incorporation deed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá (RPP) — Servicios en Línea / Trámites en Línea at rpp.gob.pa, for electronic submission of the name search and issuance of the Certificado de No Registro de Nombre (name clearance certificate).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The public deed must be executed in Spanish or bilingually in Spanish-English before a Panamanian notary. The registered corporate name may be in a foreign language but must be rendered in Latin alphabet characters and in a transliteration readable under Spanish orthographic rules. The name must include a corporate suffix equivalent to 'S.A.', 'Sociedad Anónima', 'Inc.', 'Corp.', 'Ltd.' or 'Limitada', must be genuinely distinctive, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name or a trademark protected in Panama, and must not contravene public order, morality, or national interests.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RPP rejects the proposed name, the promoter or resident agent must file, within five (5) business days of notification, a formal 'Recurso de Apelación' addressed to the Director General del Registro Público, attaching the written rejection, a revised or defended name proposal, and supporting evidence of intellectual property or registry due diligence. If the rejection is grounded on a regulatory restriction, prior written authorization from the competent Panamanian authority (e.g., Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá, SSNF, Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros de Panamá, or Ministerio de Gobierno) must be obtained and submitted. After final administrative exhaustion, the applicant may pursue a 'Demanda Contencioso-Administrativa' before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia under the Código Judicial, or alternatively re-file the name clearance application with a new distinctive token at no additional statutory fee if re-submitted within the same 30-day validation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with limitation: the statutory registered office of the Sociedad Anónima must be located in Panama at the physical seat of a licensed resident agent (an admitted Panamanian attorney or registered law firm). A virtual mailing or correspondence office is acceptable for foreign-managed CAD/BIM outsourcing entities provided the company does not derive Panama-source income, the UBO's real operating addresses are disclosed to the resident agent, and the private client file maintains complete substance documentation. If the entity were later to generate Panama-source engineering services revenue, Ley No. 254 de 2019 economic-substance evidence (local management, staff, and records) would become mandatory and a mere virtual office would be inadequate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 5% per annum during the first three years for the stated low-risk CAD outsourcing profile; the RPP does not conduct on-site visits, and the SSNF and DGI inspections are historically directed to fiduciary service providers, banks, fintech, gaming, and high-risk sectors. For a purely offshore bilingual BIM drafting operation with no Panama-source revenue and clean sanctions/KYB profiling, the realistic likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection is below 3% per annum.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of Panama

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Law No. 32 of 1927, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009 and subsequent reforms), Articles 1-120 (Formation), Articles 5-6 (Capital), Article 36 (Officers), Articles 53-57 (Registered Office and Resident Agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama), Sección de Micropelículas y Registro de Personas Jurídicas
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Notarial Public Deed) or Pacto Social / Estatutos en Documento Privado Autenticado, submitted for inscription via the 'Trámite de Registro de Sociedad Anónima'
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required at incorporation; the standard share capital clause sets a floor of USD 10,000 divided into shares of no par value (representative capital), but no escrow or deposit obligation is imposed. One or more shares may be subscribed at incorporation, and non-resident founders may subscribe 100% of the capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, THAT the Company accepts the subscription of Twenty Thousand (20,000) common shares of no par value, issued to the initial subscriber at a stated value of One United States Dollar (US$1.00) per share, receipt of which is acknowledged, and such shares are declared fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED, FURTHER, THAT the registered office of the Company be, and it hereby is, established at the offices of the Resident Agent in Panama City, Republic of Panama. RESOLVED, FURTHER, THAT [Name] be appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each to serve indefinitely until successor officers are elected. RESOLVED, FURTHER, THAT the firm of [Certified Public Accountant] is appointed statutory auditor for the fiscal year and the issuance of the corresponding corporate books is authorized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Departamento de Nombre Comercial (Online Portal: 'Operaciones en Línea' / presential window at Avenida Samuel Lewis, Panama City)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name search request for the proposed denomination (e.g., 'XYZ BIM Engineering, S.A.') to confirm that no identical or confusingly similar corporate name is registered. Submit the application via the online portal or in person, pay the search fee, and obtain a formal Certificate of Name Availability. The reservation is valid for 25 business days, during which the drafting of the incorporation deed must be completed.
required_dossiers: Name search application form (Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre)
Payment receipt for search fee
Representative's passport copy (if foreign, notarized and apostilled)
Scope description: engineering CAD/BIM consulting services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, request a re-search with a modified alternative name (up to three variants) and file a written reconsideration with the Registry's Legal Department; any conflicting prior registration must be resolved by obtaining a release letter or selecting a new name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization, and Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama (Notaría Primera del Circuito), jointly engaged with a licensed Panamanian attorney who will later act as Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the attorney to prepare the Escritura Pública de Constitución including the Articles of Incorporation (Estatutos) with: corporate name, purpose (engineering drafting and BIM outsourcing), share capital structure (US$10,000 floor), registered office address, term (undefined or fixed), and the appointment of the first directors. Execute the deed before the Notary Public with the subscribing shareholders (or a single shareholder acting by power of attorney). The attorney must also sign the acceptance of the office of Resident Agent (Carta de Aceptación) and inscribe the notarial protocol.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Name Availability
Draft Articles of Incorporation (Estatutos)
Passport copies of all subscribing shareholders (or notarized power of attorney)
Power of attorney in favor of the Panamanian incorporation attorney (if applicable)
Resident Agent acceptance letter
Proof of payment of notarial fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary Public issues a defect or formal protest (observación), amend the affected articles and re-execute the deed; minor typographical errors are corrected via an amendment deed (Aclaración y Corrección) before presentation to the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Inscription at the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three certified copies of the notarial deed along with a stamped application to the Public Registry for inscription (inscripción). The Registry examines the deed for legal conformity with Law 32 of 1927 (as amended). Upon approval, the company is issued its 'Ficha' (corporate record) and 'Aviso de Inscripción', after which the company acquires legal personality.
required_dossiers: Three certified copies of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Application for inscription (solicitud de inscripción)
Notarial fee receipts
Registry fee payment voucher (US$250 base, plus page fees)
Resident Agent acceptance letter (if not included in the deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a provisional rejection (defecto de fondo), file a corrective writing within the statutory grace period, resubmit the deed with the required amendments, and pay the re-entry fee; if the rejection is final, appeal to the Director of the Public Registry within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Resident Agent and Registration of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá / Licensed Resident Agent (Panamanian attorney or trust company)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the Resident Agent (licensed lawyer or trust company) is formally recorded in the Ficha and has accepted the office. File the 'Nombramiento de Directores y Funcionarios' with the identification of President, Secretary, and Treasurer, as well as the domiciliation address in Panama City. The Resident Agent maintains the statutory corporate books and receives official service of process.
required_dossiers: Signed acceptance of the Resident Agent
Appointment of officers form (Poder / Acta de Junta Directiva)
Copy of the first board resolution approving officers
ID/passport copies of each appointed officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any inconsistency in the officer appointment by filing an amendment act (Acta de Rectificación) with the Registry; if the Resident Agent resigns, the company has 30 days to appoint a substitute and file the corresponding notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Tax Identification Number (RUC) and Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Municipality of Panama (sección de avisos de operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the DGI to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) using the notarial deed and the 'RUC digital' online system. File the company's estimated income and the 'Aviso de Operación' with the Municipality of Panama for the operation of an administrative/professional services office. Obtain a provisional water, sewer, and solid waste clearance from the municipal sanitation department.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered public deed
Ficha from the Public Registry
Taxpayer registration application (Solicitud de RUC)
Company address and lease contract of the registered office
Municipal aviso de operación application
Copy of directors' identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is queried due to address discrepancies, update the registry with a new address certificate and re-submit; for municipal issues, present the corrected lease and pay the municipal administrative fine to lift the suspension.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Corporate Books and Issuance of Registered Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Resident Agent / Certified Public Accountant licensed by the DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the Resident Agent or the statutory auditor to authorize the corporate ledger (Libro de Accionistas), minutes book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea), and board minutes book, stamping each page with the Registry seal. Issue the physical share certificates to the founder subscribers and record the subscription in the share ledger. Retain a copy of the first board resolution for the corporate records.
required_dossiers: First board resolution minutes
Application for seal/stamping of corporate books at the Public Registry
Share certificate stub books
Subscription payment records (notarized receipts, if applicable)
Payment of stamp tax (Papel sellado) receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry refuses to seal the books due to incomplete minutes, prepare a corrective board resolution with full date and signatures, pay the corresponding rectification fee, and re-present the books within 10 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Estándares y Tecnología del Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (for export services no separate industrial permit is required)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Municipal (Municipal Operating Notice) – sufficient for an administrative engineering/CAD services office; no professional engineering license quota applies since services are rendered exclusively to foreign principals without local construction supervision

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Normas Ambientales
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I – Environmental Registration / Ficha Ambiental (Registro de Operación para actividades de bajo impacto), applied under Decreto Ejecutivo No. 57 of 2014; an office-only CAD/BIM operation without workshops or generators is treated as exempt from a full EIA report
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial discharge – office wastewater connects to municipal sewer system (must comply with MiAMBIENTE Resolution for Domestic Wastewater: BOD5 ≤ 250 mg/L, COD ≤ 500 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L, pH 6.0–9.0); no VOC process emissions as no printing or coating operations are conducted; electronic waste (used plotter cartridges, computers) must be handled by a MiAMBIENTE-authorized recycler with manifest records

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá – fire safety inspection certificate (Certificado de Seguridad Contra Incendios) covering the registered office's fire extinguishers, emergency egress, and alarm systems; Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal structural load verification and occupancy certificate (Permiso de Uso de Suelo) for the administrative office; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) workplace health and safety clearance for office workstations, electrical safety, and ergonomic compliance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), under the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF). Online portal: Sede Electrónica DGI (https://sede.dgi.gob.pa) for RUC registration, ITBMS management, and electronic invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity forming a Panama Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) must: (1) appoint a resident Panamanian attorney and a resident agent (required by law); (2) incorporate via the Public Registry; (3) obtain a resident legal representative and provide the corporate charter, director identification, and proof of local registered office; (4) apply for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) through the DGI Sede Electrónica, submitting an incorporation certificate, notarized by-laws, and identity documents; (5) register for ITBMS (VAT) in the same RUC process; (6) obtain a digital signature (Firma Digital) from a licensed authority; and (7) complete the export service registration (Régimen de Exportador) if claiming zero-rated export treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope (Entity-level taxation applies to Panama-sourced income only; offshore export services are outside Panama-source unless deemed executed within Panama).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch regimes exist under Panamanian law. Available elections include: (1) Small Taxpayer 'Régimen Simplificado' for ITBMS (optional, annual turnover up to B/.150,000); (2) Election to register as an 'Empresa Multinacional' (SEM) under Law 41/2007 or Multinational Headquarters regime, granting special tax stability; (3) Request for a private tax ruling (Registro de Voto o Consulta) to confirm the export zero-rating treatment of specific service contracts.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS – Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (VAT-equivalent), governed by Fiscal Code Articles 1043–1066 and Law 18/2018.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general exemption threshold; all persons engaged in taxable service activities in Panama must obtain RUC and register for ITBMS. A simplified regime (Régimen Simplificado) applies to small taxpayers with annual gross receipts up to B/.150,000, permitting quarterly flat payments.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory nationwide electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Panamá) under DGI Resolution 201-0108 of 2020. Taxpayers must issue invoices through DGI-authorised software, integrate via API, transmit each invoice to the DGI for real-time fiscal validation, and include a digital stamp (Código QR and electronic signature). Export invoices must carry the zero-rate indicator and the exporter's registration code.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% ITBMS applies to exports of services under Fiscal Code Art. 1050(e) when: (a) the recipient of the service is a non-resident legal entity or individual; (b) the service is actually used, consumed, or economically exploited entirely outside Panama; (c) the service is rendered for offshore goods or projects (e.g., CAD/BIM for international civil infrastructure); and (d) the service provider files the 'Declaración de Exportador de Servicios' with the DGI. The taxpayer must also maintain a direct cost-and-benefit allocation showing no local consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (for goods, if any, or 'Declaración de Exportación de Servicios' for offshore service contracts)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (only when physical deliverables are shipped; otherwise proof of electronic delivery is accepted)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT statement evidencing payment from the non-resident client
Executed service agreement identifying the offshore nature and use of the BIM/CAD deliverables
Certificate of non-residence of the client (or equivalent tax residence certificate)
Detailed invoice describing the service and zero-rating reference
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama has no statutory FX repatriation deadline as the national currency is the US dollar; however, DGI audit scrutiny requires documented receipt of export proceeds within a reasonable commercial period (typically 180 days). If the DGI determines that the export zero-rating was applied fraudulently or without genuine offshore use, it will (a) claw back the unpaid ITBMS plus default interest (calculated from the original invoice date), (b) impose fines up to 200% of the tax due or B/.50,000, and (c) in case of criminal tax evasion, pursue imprisonment under Fiscal Code Art. 856 penalties. The exporter may also be struck from the exporter registry and lose the ability to issue zero-rated invoices for three (3) years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of Panama has no central bank for monetary issuance or exchange-rate management. Banking and AML/CFT supervision is exercised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); financial-intelligence functions sit with the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); and the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) administers the territorial income tax and registers service exporters. The balboa (PAB) is legal tender only in coin form at a fixed 1:1 parity with the United States dollar, which is otherwise the circulating legal tender and settlement currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility by structural design. Both current-account flows (CAD/BIM service fees, software subscriptions, subcontractor payments) and capital-account flows (shareholder capital injections, shareholder loans, dividend remittances) are unrestricted; no prior exchange-control authorization, license, or transaction-level declaration is required for USD receipts or disbursements. Profit remittance is effected freely by wire, subject only to (i) standard bank KYC and OFAC screening, (ii) the territorial tax framework, and (iii) the dividend withholding rules: distributions sourced from Panamanian-source taxable profits bear a 10% withholding tax, whereas distributions demonstrably sourced from foreign/territorial service income are outside the withholding net, provided the corporation maintains separate profit-source accounting and rebuts the presumptive-allocation rules introduced by Law 8 of 2018.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation on export proceeds or foreign-service revenues. The CAD/BIM business bank is outside any exchange-control mechanism, and foreign-source service income remains outside the territorial income-tax base unless attributable to a Panamanian permanent establishment. Registration as a service exporter with the MEF (for ITBMS zero-rating) is recommended to corroborate the foreign-source nature of receivables before the DGI and the onboarding bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente) and Capital Escrow Account for contract-secured proceeds
Operational USD Corporate Account with Foreign-Trade Desk

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC Credomatic Panamá (BAC International Bank, Inc.)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Corporate Account and Escrow-Account facility
Operational USD Corporate Account and Treasury/Escrow Account
Operational USD Corporate Account (main government-adjacent bank)
Operational USD Corporate Account oriented to international trade and offshore structures
Operational USD Corporate Account (high minimum-balance and global-compliance threshold)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM for receivable collection and low-value disbursement, LOW as a primary treasury or clearing venue. Panama does not recognize the foreign 'Electronic Money Institution (EMI)' authorization; Wise (Wise, Inc.) and Payoneer hold no Panamanian banking license and cannot open a regulated domestic settlement account with SBP oversight. They may be used solely as inbound collection ramps for small CAD/BIM invoices, with an automated sweep (via SWIFT or local ACH) into a Tier 1 Panamanian bank account. All material contract proceeds and trade payments must ultimately terminate at, or originate from, a licensed Panamanian credit institution to preserve clean audit trails and to support the territorial-income characterization before the DGI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under SBP AML Rule 4-2022 (as amended), every regulated bank must conduct a personal interview with the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and the legal representative before account activation. The interview may be completed by secure audio-visual means, and remote document intake is generally accepted, but in practice the Tier 1 Panamanian banks require at least one officer or UBO to attend an in-branch interview in Panama City for the corporate account to be fully activated. Apostilled constitutional documents, a sworn UBO affidavit, and a letter from the resident agent (registered agent) are mandatory for remote opening; a physical visit materially accelerates risk approval and is therefore factually the practical prerequisite for a first treasury account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or legal representative is a tax resident or national of an FATF grey-listed or SBP high-risk jurisdiction (e.g., UAE, Seychelles, Curaçao) and/or is acting through a nominee directorship.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UAF Registro de Beneficiarios Finales certificate, tax-residence certificates, notarized source-of-wealth statement, professional reference letters from the Panamanian resident-agent firm, apostilled passport copy, and bank reference letters from each remitting/contributing bank covering a minimum 12-month relationship history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction-profile mismatch: ISIC 7110 (CAD/BIM drafting) entity receives high-velocity USD inflows from a single offshore parent without commensurate operational expenditure or any physical employees in Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Master Services Agreement and statement-of-work registers, BIM/structural deliverable evidence (Revit/AutoCAD export logs, version history, client review records), monthly invoice register, corporate organizational chart, DGI service-exporter registration, and a 12-month cash-flow forecast mapping expected inflows to POs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lump-sum capital injection or third-party disbursements to subcontractors in jurisdictions that do not match the client's declared end-markets (e.g., Philippine or Indian structural-drafting subcontractors).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board minutes approving the injection and each material disbursement; source-of-funds letter from the contributing bank; executed subcontractor agreements with corresponding invoices; SWIFT beneficiary identification package; FATCA/CRS self-certifications for each payee; and a treasury-mapping statement matching each outbound MT103 to a contract milestone.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Corporate-ownership complexity: shares of the S.A. held by a Panama Private Interest Foundation (PIF) with discretionary beneficiaries, creating partial opacity in the UBO chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foundation deed and council resolution, the S.A.'s registered-share register evidencing no bearer shares (bearer instruments abolished under Law 47 of 2013), a Panamanian legal opinion confirming UBO identification under Law 23 of 2015, the UAF final-beneficiary declaration, and a UBO attestation executed by the foundation council under penalty of perjury.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder funds are transmitted by SWIFT MT103 in USD via CHIPS/Fedwire to the Panamanian bank's nostro or clearing account, crediting the corporate operational account on the same value date. Panama prescribes no statutory purpose code; the beneficiary narrative should read 'Capital Contribution – Aporte de Capital – [Board Resolution Date/No.]' and will be classified by the receiving bank under the BPM6 direct-investment (equity) category. Supporting verification pack for the onboarding file: board minutes approving the injection, updated share ledger, sworn 'Declaración Jurada de Aporte de Capital' where requested by the bank, and, if capital is to be reflected in the Registro Público, the corresponding registration form. No exchange-control validation or central-bank approval applies; the sole substantive controls are bank-side source-of-funds verification and OFAC screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for subcontractor fees, SaaS licenses, design-processor payments, reimbursements, and dividend remittances; each message should carry a contract or invoice reference to satisfy SBP transaction-monitoring expectations. Domestic USD clearing of payroll and local vendor payments uses the Panamanian ACH (ACH Panama) and immediate-demand-deposit transfers. Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700) are materially unnecessary for CAD/BIM service flows and are reserved for one-off procurement of design hardware or software-enterprise licenses above USD 100,000 where the counterparty requires bank-guaranteed settlement. No exchange-control license is required for any outbound USD wire; the bank's automated OFAC/SDN screening is the operative compliance gate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC spot FX conversions from non-USD receivables (EUR, CAD, GBP) into USD, executed with a licensed Panamanian bank or international dealing room; no SBP approval required.
OTC cross-currency forwards (EUR/USD, CAD/USD) booked under an ISDA/CSA with a qualified international bank, deliverable in USD only, since the domestic monetary circulation is dollarized.

Cross-currency swaps on matched receivable pipelines (e.g., EUR-denominated BIM project invoices swapped into USD) with term counterparties, permitted under Panamanian private law and not subject to exchange-control restrictions.
FX options (call/put structures on USD) transacted through foreign dealing rooms for contingency hedging of major project awards; legally valid and enforceable absent any central-bank prohibition.

Deliverable or non-deliverable local-currency forwards are functionally inapplicable: the balboa is pegged at 1:1 to the USD with no central-bank reference rate, so hedging is limited to cross-currency instruments against other foreign currencies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual) - Panama Corporation Renewal Levy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI, Ministry of Economy and Finance), Sistema E-Tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 15 March each calendar year; USD 300 where authorized capital is USD 10,000 or less, USD 400 where authorized capital exceeds USD 10,000; the first assessment for a newly registered Sociedad Anónima falls due on the next statutory cycle following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues a 10% surcharge plus 1% monthly interest on the unpaid fee; continued non-payment for three consecutive years authorizes administrative dissolution (strike-off) by the Public Registry; the resident agent may resign and trigger winding-up proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report (Informe Anual) - secretarial confirmation of directors, officers, shareholders, and registered office, filed electronically by the resident agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección Nacional de Registro de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry, Legal Entities Division)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each year; aligned with the annual Tasa Única renewal cycle for the same assessment year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission incurs monthly registry fines until compliance; non-filing for two consecutive years, combined with an unpaid Tasa Única, subjects the Sociedad Anónima to administrative removal from the Public Registry and loss of juridical personality

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Renta, Form 271 for legal entities) - required only if Panamanian-source (territorial) income was generated during the fiscal period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI, Ministry of Economy and Finance), Sistema E-Tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the close of the fiscal year (calendar year); offshore Sociedades Anónimas deriving exclusively foreign-source income are generally outside the filing obligation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Where a filing obligation exists, late submission triggers a 10% surcharge on the assessed tax plus 1% monthly interest and administrative fines in the range of USD 50 to USD 500; persistent non-filing authorizes the DGI to open a tax audit and initiate asset attachment procedures

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit certification of financial statements by a Panama-licensed certified public accountant applies when gross annual Panamanian-source taxable income exceeds USD 500,000 (administrative criteria also reference gross assets above USD 3,000,000); entities in regulated sectors (banking, insurance, trust services), entities expressly required by the DGI, and companies that voluntarily elect audit are likewise subject to the requirement. The offshore BIM/CAD outsourcing S.A. below the threshold may present unaudited financial statements with its annual declaration.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as adopted by the Panamanian College of Public Accountants; simplified IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para Pymes) is available for small and medium entities not classified as public-interest entities. Books and financial records must be maintained in Spanish or English, with monetary amounts expressed in United States dollars or Balboas at par, and retained for the statutory limitation period.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 254 of 2021 (Ultimate Beneficial Owner Registry) and its implementing DGI regulations, the resident agent must maintain the UBO declaration in the DGI E-Tax module and ratify it at least annually in connection with the Tasa Única renewal cycle. Any share transfer that changes the ultimate beneficial owner (control or a 15% or greater equity interest) must be declared within 30 days of execution; the annual ratification is embedded in the corporate renewal filing window.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 - USD 1,800 per annum for a standard Panama resident-agency and registered-office package (government fees excluded)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 4,500 per annum for a certified IFRS/SME audit by a Panama-licensed CPA; not required below the USD 500,000 gross-income threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial exemption: income derived from export of engineering/CAD/BIM services to foreign clients (invoiced, paid, and used outside Panama) is not attributed a Panamanian source and is exempt from the corporate income tax, producing an effective 0% rate on the offshore revenue stream; preferential 5% rate available for certified SEM (Multinational Headquarters) operations under Law 41 of 2007; no minimum capital requirement applies to the Sociedad Anonima.
